data.longBusinessSummary: Texas Roadhouse, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates casual dining restaurants in the United States and internationally. It operates through Texas Roadhouse, Bubba's 33, and Other segments. The company also operates and franchises restaurants under the Texas Roadhouse, Bubba's 33, and Jaggers brands. Texas Roadhouse, Inc. was founded in 1993 and is based in Louisville, Kentucky.
